summary: Read several closed ranges. Each range is given by two integers, a left end and a right end. When two ranges cross, or meet at an endpoint, replace them by one longer range whose ends cover both original pieces. Keep doing this until the ranges that remain no longer meet. Write every range that is left, ordered by increasing left ends. A shared endpoint is enough to join two ranges.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
